svg.title: Cybersecurity analyst — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as cybersecurity analyst, wearing a tailored jacket. Visible work cue: A protective cybersecurity shield surrounds a clearly closed padlock with a separate curved shackle. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: short curls, a tapered face and round glasses.
